Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): よう！調子はどうだ。
Text (EN): Yo! How's it going?

Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): くくく……。少し前まで、いかにも駆け出しの新人……って様子だったが、すっかり走り屋が板についてきたな。
Text (EN): Heh heh heh... Not long ago, you looked like a total rookie fresh off the streets... But now you've really grown into a proper street racer.

Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): 12時過ぎのシンデレラに勝ったんだろ？彼女ほどの走り屋に実力を認められたお前さんは、伝説の存在である迅帝に挑戦する“資格”の持ち主かもしれない。
Text (EN): You beat 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】, didn't you? If a racer of her caliber acknowledged your skills, you might just have what it takes to challenge the legendary 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): その代わり……迅帝への復讐を目的に掲げるスネークアイズ……そして、奴が率いる<Phantom9>からは完全にターゲットされちまったようだ。
Text (EN): But that also means... 【SNAKE EYES】, who's hell-bent on revenge against 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, and his crew 《Phantom9》 have got you squarely in their sights.

Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): そんなお前さんの対抗馬たりうるのは、新世代の有力な走り屋たちだろう。特に久遠のポラリス――くくく、どれほどの実力を秘めているのかねェ……。
Text (EN): The only ones who can match you now are the new generation's top racers. Especially 【ETERNAL POLARIS】― Heh heh heh, I wonder what kind of power she's hiding...

Heading: To the Next Stage
Text (JP): ――新たなSTAGEで、新たなライバルたちがお前さんを待ち受けているようだぜ。くくく……。
Text (EN): A new stage awaits, with new rivals ready to take you on. Heh heh heh...

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): おんしが観光客いう走り屋かえ？
Text (EN): So you're the street racer they call 【{bad_name}】?

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): わしは<Be Legend>が一員、不動心の龍馬。元・十三鬼将の名にかけて、おんしにバトルを挑むぜよ……
Text (EN): I'm 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 of 《Be Legend》. On my honor as a former member of the THIRTEEN DEVILS, I challenge you to battle...

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): 突然、和装の男に土佐弁で話しかけられたことで面食らっていると、遠くから空気を震わす甲高いエンジンサウンドが聞こえてきた。不動心の龍馬も気をひかれたようで、2人そろってPAの入り口に注目する。
Text (EN): Caught off guard by the man in traditional Japanese clothing speaking in Tosa dialect, I was still processing when a piercing engine sound cut through the air from the distance. 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 seemed drawn to it too, and we both turned our attention to the PA entrance.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): そこへ現れたのは、悪魔がまとう衣のような漆黒のS2000だった。降りてきた人物が、こちらへ向かって真っすぐに歩いてくる。
Text (EN): What appeared was a jet-black S2000, dark as a demon's cloak. The figures who stepped out began walking straight toward us.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): スマートな風貌であり、どちらかというと物静かな印象の男だ。しかし、歴戦の走り屋が持つ特有の闘争本能が、隠し切れないプレッシャーを周囲に漂わせていた。
Text (EN): He had a refined appearance and seemed rather quiet at first glance. But the primal fighting instinct of a seasoned street racer radiated an unmistakable air all around him.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): しばらくぶりに首都環状に戻ってみれば……早速、かつての相棒に再会できるとはな。
Text (EN): I return to the Shuto Expressway after all this time... And the first thing I find is my old partner.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): お……おんしはルシファー大塚！？あ、あ、あ、会いたかったぜよ～～～！！！
Text (EN): Y-You're 【Lucifer Otsuka】?! I-I-I've been wanting to see you sooooo bad!!!

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): いや……待てよ。おんしが戻って来た……ということは……！？
Text (EN): Wait, hold on... If you're back, that means...!

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): ああ、スティールハートさんも一緒だ。新時代の走り屋ってやつにお目にかかりたくてね。俺たちだけじゃなく、他の元・十三鬼将の連中も続々と集まっているらしい。
Text (EN): Yeah, 【STEEL HEART】 is here too. We wanted to see what these new era racers are made of. Not just us―other former THIRTEEN DEVILS are gathering as well.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): そんなことになっちょったがかえ……こりゃあまっこと、“首都環状の夜明け”ぜよ！
Text (EN): So that's what's happening... This truly is the dawn of the Shuto Expressway!

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): そういうことやったら、わしは<Be Legend>を脱退する！――“走りの道は一つということはない、道は百も千も万もある”。うちのリーダーは話の分かる人やき、快く送り出してくれるはずぜよ。
Text (EN): If that's how it is, I'm leaving 《Be Legend》! "The path of racing isn't just one―there are hundreds, thousands, millions." Our leader's an understanding guy, he'll send me off with his blessing.

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): 観光客よ、スティールハート先生に挑みたいがやったら、まずはわしらを倒してみーや！
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】, if you want to challenge Master 【STEEL HEART】, you'll have to beat us first!

Heading: Storm Clouds Gathering
Text (JP): それはまあ……いいとして、大吾……少し見ない間に、随分キャラが変わったな……。
Text (EN): That's all well and good, but... Daigo... You've really changed while I was away...

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): バトルを終え、不動心の龍馬とルシファー大塚と共にPAに戻る。すると、バトルの様子を見ていたという走り屋の男が待ち構えていた。男はスティールハートと名乗った。
Text (EN): After the battle, you returned to the parking area with 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 and 【Lucifer Otsuka】. A street racer who watched the battle was waiting there. The man introduced himself as 【STEEL HEART】.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): 俺の愛弟子を2人とも倒してしまうとはな……面白い。裏切りのジャックナイフから話を聞いたときは半信半疑だったが、これだけの実力者に出会えるとは、首都環状へ戻ってきた甲斐があった。
Text (EN): Taking down both of my disciples... interesting. When 【TREACHEROUS JACKKNIFE】 told me about you, I had my doubts, but meeting such a skilled racer makes my return to the Shuto worthwhile.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): 4年前に姿を消した迅帝が帰って来た。奴の師である男と共に……。それとほとんど時を同じくして、お前が現れた。
Text (EN): 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, who vanished four years ago, has returned. Along with the man who trained him... And almost at the same time, you appeared.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): これは偶然の一致か？それとも――首都環状の魔物が呼び寄せているのか……？
Text (EN): Is this just coincidence? Or... Is the demon of the Shuto Expressway calling us together?

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): 観光客よ、ええバトルやったにゃあ。おんしはまっこと、新時代の風雲児ぜよ。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】, that was one hell of a battle. You truly are the rising star of this new era.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): それに比べてわしときたら、先生らとの再会に浮かれて相手を侮るとは、修業が足りんかった。ヨーガの修行を再開し、苦行精進した方がええかにゃあ……。
Text (EN): And here I am, getting carried away reuniting with old friends, underestimating my opponent... I need more training. Maybe I should restart my yoga practice and become an ascetic...

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): お前が物事にのめり込みやすいタイプだってことは知っていたが……前は“インドブーム”で……今は“龍馬ブーム”なのか？……まあ、役者向きの性格なのかもな。
Text (EN): I knew you were the type to get obsessed with things... Before it was the India phase, but now you're all about Ryoma? ...Well, maybe that's the perfect personality for an actor.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): ハハハ、再会したばかりの三人が演じる即興劇だが、俺たち師弟のコンビネーションを見せてやろう。
Text (EN): Hahaha, a lovely impromptu performance by three who just reunited. But we'll show you the combination of master and disciples.

Heading: Trials That Stand In Your Way
Text (JP): 他の連中への土産話にさせてもらうぞ。観光客、その実力を確かめさせてくれ。
Text (EN): This'll make a great story for the others. 【{bad_name}】, let me test that strength of yours.

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): 時を超えてなお変わらぬもの――――
Text (EN): That which remains unchanged across time────

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): 絆を通じて受け継がれ、永遠となるもの――――
Text (EN): That which is handed down through bonds, becoming eternal────

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): それは狂おしいほどの走りへの情熱
Text (EN): It is a passion for the race that borders on madness

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): 伝説の時代を駆け抜けた古き魂たち
Text (EN): Ancient souls who sprinted through the legendary era

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): 熱狂が、彼らを首都環状へ呼び戻す
Text (EN): The frenzy calls them back to the Shuto Ring

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): まだだ
Text (EN): Not yet

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): まだお前が見たことの無い世界を見せてやろう
Text (EN): Let us show you a world you have never seen before

Heading: Interlude: Melodies Being Woven
Text (JP): ――――新たな旋律が紡がれ始める
Text (EN): ────A new melody begins to weave

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): バトルを終えてPAで休み、移動しようとした途端、3台のマシンに進路を遮られた。知らない相手だが、車体に貼られたエンブレムには見覚えがある――――<Phantom9>のメンバーだ。
Text (EN): After the battle ended and they rested at the parking area, three machines blocked their path. They didn't know the opponents, but the emblems on their cars were familiar— they were 《Phantom9》 members.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): お互いにマシンを降り、品定めをするように対峙する。相手の3人組はクレイジーモンキー、ダーティーフォックス、そして砂塵の帝王と名乗った。
Text (EN): Both parties exited their machines, sizing each other up. The three opponents introduced themselves as 【CRAZY MONKEY】, 【DIRTY FOX】, and 【SANDSTORM EMPEROR】.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): アンタ、このあたりのチームを片っ端からツブして回ってるんだって？オイラたちとやってること一緒じゃね？
Text (EN): So you're the one crushing all the teams around here one by one? Ain't that exactly what we're doing?

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): ひょっとして……<Phantom9>をリスペクトしてたりする？ハハ、冗談冗談！
Text (EN): Don't tell me... You're a 《Phantom9》 fan? Haha, just kidding!

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): “キラキラ走り屋”のアンタは、アオハルを楽しんじゃってるだけでちゅもんね～。……でも、オイラたちは違うぜ。
Text (EN): You "Glitter Racer" types are just out here enjoying your youth, aren't ya? ...But we're different.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): 首都環状のすべての走り屋を徹底的に痛めつけてやれってのが、うちのリーダー……2代目スネークアイズの命令だからな。当然、お前さんもその対象だ。
Text (EN): Our leader, the second 【SNAKE EYES】, ordered us to thoroughly crush every street racer on the Shuto Expressway. Naturally, that includes you.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): ま……俺個人としては、お前さんや他チームの連中に対して、何か恨みがあるってワケでもないがね。悪く思うなよ。
Text (EN): Well... Personally, I got nothing against you or the other teams. Don't take it the wrong way.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): あ、知らなかった？今のスネークアイズは、4年前にいた先代とは別人なのヨ。先代からチームと名前を継いだのが、新しいリーダーってわけ。
Text (EN): Oh, didn't you know? The current 【SNAKE EYES】 isn't the same guy from four years ago. The new leader inherited the team and name from the predecessor.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Character (JP): ダーティーフォックス
Text (JP): そんな話どうでもいいじゃん。観光客って強いんでしょ。
Text (EN): Who cares about all that? 【{bad_name}】's supposed to be strong, right?

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Character (JP): ダーティーフォックス
Text (JP): うちのチームに興味なーい？潰しちゃうより、そっちの方がよくなーい？
Text (EN): Not interested in joining our team? That'd be way better than crushing you, don't ya think?

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): ちょちょちょ～～、コイツ入れたら “ナイン” じゃなくなっちゃうじゃ～ん？誰かクビにしないとさぁ～～。<Phantom9>に一番要らないやつをさぁ～～。
Text (EN): Whoa whoa whoa! If we add this guy, we won't be "Nine" anymore! We'd have to kick someone out! The most useless member of 《Phantom9》!

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Character (JP): ダーティーフォックス
Text (JP): え～～～～～。そんなの、オタクくんしかいなくな～～い？
Text (EN): Whaaat? But there's nobody like that except for you, nerd boy!

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Character (JP): ダーティーフォックス
Text (JP): 別に、お前でもいいけどぉ。
Text (EN): Though I guess it could be you instead.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): たは～～！ダーティーフォックスちゃん、キビシ～～！
Text (EN): Ahaha! That's harsh, 【DIRTY FOX】!

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): ま、いずれにせよスネークアイズ坊ちゃんは、メンツを潰された相手をタダで迎え入れるほど甘くはねぇよ。
Text (EN): Well, either way, young master 【SNAKE EYES】 ain't sweet enough to just welcome someone who damaged his rep.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): お前さんは黒崎三兄弟に土をつけ、<Phantom9>の名に泥を塗った……。その償いをしてもらう必要があるぜ。
Text (EN): You beat the Kurosaki Brothers and dragged 《Phantom9》's name through the mud... We need you to pay for that.

Heading: Chain of Destiny
Text (JP): そーゆーわけだから、オイラたちも本気でやらせてもらうねぇ。上下関係ってモンをはっきりさせなきゃな。アンタの挑戦、待ってるぜぇ。
Text (EN): So that's why we're gonna go all out too. Gotta make the pecking order crystal clear. We'll be waiting for your challenge.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): PAにマシンを停め、車内で休んでいるうちに、いつの間にかまどろんでいたようだ。しかし──つかの間の静寂は、小さなノックの音で遮られる。
Text (EN): They parked at the parking area and dozed off in the car without realizing it. But— The brief silence was broken by a small knock.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): 窓の外に目を向けると、紅童子が車内をのぞき込んでいた。その奥では、金色般若と鉄翁が、マシンを取り囲むように立っているのが見える。降りて来いということなのだろう。
Text (EN): Looking out the window, 【CRIMSON BOY】 was peering into the car. Behind him, 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 and 【IRON OLD MAN】 stood surrounding the machine. They wanted them to come out.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): ごきげんよう……いえ、おはようございます、新顔さん。よく休めましたか？
Text (EN): Good day... Or rather, good morning, newcomer. Did you sleep well?

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): ふふふ……露骨にイヤそうなカオですね。僕はお会いできて嬉しいですよ。
Text (EN): Hehehe... such an obviously annoyed face. I'm happy to meet you though.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): 今や、すっかり首都環状の中心人物になりましたね。神田橋のあたりを、おっかなびっくり走っていた頃とは見違えるようです。
Text (EN): You've now become the center of attention on the Shuto Expressway. A far cry from when you nervously crept around Kandabashi.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): 首都環状の歴史を作り上げたベテランの走り屋たちが次々と破られ、俺たち<Phantom9>も辛酸をなめさせられた。新世代の走り屋たちの間でも、お前は特別な存在感を放っている。
Text (EN): The veteran racers who built the Shuto Expressway's history fell one by one, and even we in 《Phantom9》 tasted bitter defeat. Among the new generation of racers, you radiate a special presence.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): チッ。まさか、ルーキー風情がここまで急成長するとはな。賭けは雅路の勝ちってわけかよ。
Text (EN): Tch. Who'd have thought some rookie would grow this fast. Guess Masamichi wins the bet.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): 観光客。お前のせいで、雅路にいちごパフェを奢らなきゃなんねーだろうが！
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】! Thanks to you, I gotta buy Masamichi a strawberry parfait!

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): しかし、俺たち“黒崎三兄弟”を倒したつもりになってもらっては困る。先日のバトルはあくまで腕試しだ。
Text (EN): However, don't think you've defeated the Kurosaki Brothers just yet. Our previous battle was merely a test.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): 今度は俺たち三人の真の実力をもって、お前に挑ませてもらう。
Text (EN): This time, we three will challenge you with our true power.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-1
Text (JP): お前のために、とっておきのマシンを出してやるからよ。ありがたく思え。
Text (EN): I'm bringing out my special machine just for you. You'd better appreciate it.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): なるほど、これがあなたの実力ですか……。僕たちの力をすべて出し切ったつもりでしたが、負けてしまいましたね。
Text (EN): So this is your true strength... We gave it everything we had, but we still lost.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): ふん。まぁ、ルーキーにしては上出来じゃねえか。
Text (EN): Hmph. Not bad for a rookie, I'll give you that.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): うちのリーダー……2代目スネークアイズは、あなたのような走り屋が台頭することを期待しています。なにせ……迅帝をおびき出すエサとして、うってつけの存在だ。
Text (EN): Our leader, the second 【SNAKE EYES】... He's been expecting a racer like you to emerge. After all... you're the perfect bait to draw out the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): どうやら迅帝は“新たな挑戦者”にしか興味がないらしいんですよねぇ……。彼を闘いの舞台に引きずり出すには、生贄となる“今もっともアツい走り屋”が必要なんです。
Text (EN): Apparently the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 only cares about new challengers... To drag him back onto the battlefield, we need a sacrifice—the hottest racer of the moment.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): しかし……これで<Phantom9>も、残すところはあとNAMAHAGEひとりだけか。クソッ……情けねー。
Text (EN): But damn... with this, 《Phantom9》 is down to just 【NAMAHAGE】. Shit, how pathetic...

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): ふむ…………観光客はNAMAHAGEのことを知らないようだな。
Text (EN): Hmm... 【{bad_name}】 doesn't seem to know about 【NAMAHAGE】.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): <Phantom9>のメンバーとして活動するようになった頃から、いくつかの名前を使い分けていたらしいからな。つかみどころのない男だ。
Text (EN): Since he started working as a member of 《Phantom9》, he's been using several different names. He's an elusive man.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): かつての名はパープルメテオ。迅帝以前に首都環状の頂点に立った、伝説の時代の走り屋さ。
Text (EN): His former name was 【PURPLE METEOR】, the legendary Street Racer who ruled the Shuto Expressway before 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Showdown: Kurosaki Three Brothers-2
Text (JP): そして、彼は迅帝の師匠でもある。そう……、自らの弟子と敵対するスネークアイズの側についた、いわば裏切り者なんです。 面白い方でしょ？
Text (EN): And he's also the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】's mentor. Yes, a traitor who sided with 【SNAKE EYES】 against his own disciple... Quite the interesting character, don't you think?

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 全ての魂を生贄に捧げよーーーーー
Text (EN): Offer up every soul as a sacrifice────

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 復讐の闇に潜む者の命により、繰り返し襲い来る刺客たち
Text (EN): By order of the one lurking in the shadows of vengeance, assassins attack again and again

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 振り払う度、振り払う度
Text (EN): With every strike shaken off, with every foe repelled

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 標的にされた魂は純度を増してゆく
Text (EN): The targeted soul gains ever greater purity

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): ーーーーーそれは悪夢の再演
Text (EN): ────That is the replay of nightmares

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 失われた伝説を蘇らせる儀式
Text (EN): A ritual to resurrect the lost legend

Heading: Interlude: Replay of Nightmares
Text (JP): 執念の鎖は、哀れな生贄の喉笛に食い込み、決して離そうとしない

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): PAで休憩がてら、タイヤの具合を確認していると、3人組の走り屋に声をかけられた。
Text (EN): While taking a break at the parking area to check your tires, a trio of racers approached you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): 1人は豪放磊落を絵に描いたような、壮年のむくつけき大男。もう1人は対照的な、洒脱な雰囲気で甘いマスクの男。そしてもう1人は、知的で洗練された印象のキャリアウーマン風の女だ。
Text (EN): One was a burly middle-aged man who looked like the very picture of bold and hearty. Another was his complete opposite—a suave man with refined charm and handsome features. And the third was a woman with the air of a sophisticated, intellectual career professional.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): おお、観光客しゃんやなかと。お目にかかれてうれしか。わしゃライジングシーマンちゅうもんばい。
Text (EN): Oh, if it ain't 【{bad_name}】! Pleased to make yer acquaintance. Name's 【RISING SEAMAN】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): そちらん2人は愛のトルナードしゃんと噂のライターしゃん。意外かもしれんが、わしはこう見て、九州は博多からやってきたもんで、首都環状には詳しゅうなかけん、おふたりに案内してもろうとーと。
Text (EN): These two are 【TORNADO OF LOVE】 and 【RUMORED WRITER】. It might surprise ya, but I came all the way from Hakata in Kyushu, so I don't know the Shuto Expressway well—they're showin' me around.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): あんた、久遠のポラリスを倒したんだろ？上には上がいるもんだねぇ。俺らもあの子とバトルしたが、手ごわい相手だったのにな。
Text (EN): You beat 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, right? There's always someone better out there. We battled that kid too—tough opponent.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): 知ってるかしら？最近の首都環状は、貴方と久遠のポラリスの話題で持ちきりなのよ。
Text (EN): Did you know? The whole Shuto Expressway is buzzing about you and 【ETERNAL POLARIS】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): ああ、ミッドナイトローズが久遠のポラリスをすっかり気に入って、“首都環状女子の会” に招待したとか。あんたがユウウツな天使の助手席に乗って、コーナー３つで失神したとかな。
Text (EN): Yeah, about 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】 taking a real liking to 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, even inviting her to the Shuto Expressway Girls' Club. And about how you passed out after three corners riding shotgun with 【MELANCHOLIC ANGEL】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): あんたが、屈強な男どもが揃う<STRONG FORMATION>とバトルして、ぎったんぎったんにしただけじゃ飽き足らず、11人全員ずらりと土下座させ、詫び入れさせなさったっちゅう話もきいとりますばい。
Text (EN): I also heard ya battled those tough guys from 《STRONG FORMATION》, and not only beat 'em senseless, but made all eleven of 'em line up and grovel for forgiveness!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): 大黒PAにデカい鉄板を持ち込んで、<HARISEN Chop>と “粉もん対決” したとか聞いたけど、何考えてんだ？
Text (EN): I heard you brought a huge griddle to Daikoku Parking Area and had a flour-food showdown with 《HARISEN Chop》. What were you thinking?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): マシンには自動小銃ば仕込んどって、いざとなったら銃撃戦もしなさるっちゅうん、ほんなこつね？
Text (EN): Is it true you've got a machine gun rigged up in your ride, ready to unleash hell in a shootout if things go south?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): ……。そうよね、流石に根も葉もないデマよね。
Text (EN): ... Right, of course those are just baseless rumors.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: That Guy Everyone's Talking About
Text (JP): ちょっと噂に尾ひれがついてるみたいだけど……。ここで会ったのも何かの縁だし、あなたの本当の姿……取材させて頂戴。
Text (EN): Seems like the rumors have grown some extra tails... But meeting you here must be fate. Let me interview you... Show me who you really are.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): PAを歩いていると、先ほどバトルした噂のライターのマシンを見かけた。ふと、疑問が浮かぶ。バトル中に突然出てきた、怪しい煙幕は一体なんだったのか？
Text (EN): Walking through the parking area, you spotted the machine of the 【RUMORED WRITER】 you just battled. A question suddenly came to mind: What was that suspicious smoke screen that appeared during the battle?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): あれは、噂のライターが使った罠なのだろうか？興味が湧き、もっとよく見ようとしてマシンに近づく。その瞬間――――不意に、背後から声をかけられた。
Text (EN): Was it a trap set by 【RUMORED WRITER】? Curiosity piqued, you approached the machine for a closer look— and at that moment, a voice suddenly called out from behind.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): ――――私のマシンは、誰にも触らせないことにしてるの。ごめんなさいね。
Text (EN): I don't let anyone touch my machine. Sorry about that.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): さっきのバトル、楽しかったわ。思わず、秘蔵の“七つ道具”を使ってしまったけれど……私の存在が日本当局にバレると、色々とマズイのよ。
Text (EN): That battle was fun. I couldn't help but use one of my secret "seven tools"... It'd be problematic if the Japanese authorities found out about me.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): 見逃してくれたら、貴方に関する噂は、私がうまく処理してあげる。ほとんどは無害な内容だけど、中には悪質なデマを流布している者もいるらしいの。有名になりすぎたわね。
Text (EN): If you let this slide, I'll handle the rumors about you. Most are harmless, but some are spreading malicious lies. You've become too famous.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): 私に任せてくれれば――――しばらくは変な目で見られるかもしれないけど、そのうち皆、つまらない噂話には飽きて忘れてしまうでしょう。
Text (EN): Leave it to me. People might look at you strangely for a while, but eventually they'll get bored and forget all about it.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): 彼女はいったい何者なのか？色々と尋ねてみたい気持ちはあったが、ここは条件を飲むことにした。
Text (EN): Who exactly was she? Though curious to ask more, you decided to accept her terms.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Turn Signals Are Danger Signs
Text (JP): だけど、気を付けて……。貴方の名前を騙って悪事を働く者がいるかもしれない……。
Text (EN): But be careful... Someone might be using your name to commit crimes...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice
Text (JP): ひと気のないPAで、少女が自分のマシンに寄り添うように、ぽつんと独り、うつむきながら立っている。時おり顔を上げては周囲を見回し、夜の音にじっと耳を澄ませる。
Text (EN): In the deserted parking area, a girl stood alone by her machine, head down and looking lost in thought. Occasionally she lifted her head, scanning the area and listening intently to the night sounds.

Text (EN): A deafening exhaust roar tore through the quiet night, echoing across the parking area. An intruder suddenly appeared, aggressively pulling up beside the girl's machine.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice
Text (JP): よぉ、待ち合わせかい。悪いが、観光客なら来ないぜ。
Text (EN): Yo, waiting for someone? Too bad, 【{bad_name}】 ain't coming.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice
Text (EN): What...?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice

Text (EN): And tonight's your last night on the Shuto Expressway. Nothing personal, kid. You just made too much noise.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice
Text (JP): 俺たち<CLUB GARUDA>が覇権を握るため――――ここで消えてもらう。
Text (EN): For 《CLUB GARUDA》 to seize control... You gotta disappear.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Creeping Malice
Text (JP): …………。受けて立つ。
Text (EN): ... I accept your challenge.

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): おいおいおい、ぶったまげたなぁ。<Juicy Heven>の連中がやられちまったってよ？
Text (EN): Yo yo yo, this is insane! I heard the 《Juicy Heaven》 crew got taken down?

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): だってリーダーの誘惑のアメジストっていやぁ、米国仕込みのカウンセリング能力で、相手の心を見透かしたように走るんだぜ！多少マシンの性能差があったとしたって、勝てないだろ？普通！！
Text (EN): I mean, their leader 【TEMPTING AMETHYST】 uses her American-trained counseling skills to read her opponents like an open book! Even with a bit of a performance gap, there's no way you'd normally be able to beat that!!

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): ああ、俺も聞いた聞いた！いや、それ以外にも、様々なチームが結構やられてるって話だぜ！
Text (EN): Yeah, I heard about it too! And it's not just them—word is, tons of other teams have been getting wrecked!

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): マジかぁっ！！俺、誘惑のアメジストさん、ちょっと憧れてたからショックだわぁ～。
Text (EN): For real?! Man, I kinda looked up to 【TEMPTING AMETHYST】, so this is hitting me hard...

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): それで、その快進撃を続けてる男って、もう面は割れてんのか？お前、見たことあるか？
Text (EN): So who's this guy on a winning streak? Anyone ID'd him yet? You ever seen him?

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): 実は一度PAで見たことがあるんだけどよぉ、観光客って奴でな、なんともごく普通の兄ちゃんなんだよ。本当にコイツが噂の男なのか？って自分の目を疑っちゃったぜ。
Text (EN): I actually saw him once at a Parking Area. He goes by 【{bad_name}】, and man, he's just some regular dude. I was doubting my own eyes, like, is this really the guy everyone's talking about?

Heading: Rumor 3-1
Text (JP): でも……あいつが多くのライバルを負かし、次々と勝ち進んでるんだよ。あいつの動向には目が離せないぜ。
Text (EN): But... That's the guy who's been crushing rivals left and right, winning race after race. You can't take your eyes off what he does next.

Heading: Rumor 3-2
Text (JP): 12時過ぎのシンデレラまでもが敗れたか……。かつての伝説の走り屋たちが、ある一人の男に次々と敗北しているらしい。
Text (EN): Even 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】 has fallen... The legendary racers of old are being defeated one after another by a single man.

Heading: Rumor 3-2
Text (JP): ……首都環状では、稀にこういうことが起きるんだよ。それまでの勢力図をすっかり塗り替えちまうような奴が……。ある夜、突如として現れることがあるんだ。
Text (EN): ...This kind of thing happens on the Shuto Expressway once in a blue moon. Someone who completely rewrites the power balance... And just appears out of nowhere one night.

Heading: Rumor 3-2
Text (JP): だが、首都環状の歴史は深い。まだまだビッグネームが存在しているのさ。そういった走り屋たちも、いずれ参戦してくるだろうな。
Text (EN): But the Shuto Expressway has a long history. There are still plenty of big names out there. Those racers will join the battle sooner or later.

Heading: Rumor 3-3
Text (JP): あのスティールハートが首都環状に帰って来たそうだぜ！弟子のルシファー大塚も連れてな。これで観光客の快進撃もおしまいだぜ！
Text (EN): I heard 【STEEL HEART】 is back on the Shuto Expressway! And he brought his apprentice 【LUCIFER OTSUKA】 with him. That'll be the end of 【{bad_name}】's winning streak!

Heading: Rumor 3-3
Text (JP): ……知らないのか？スティールハートはもう、観光客に負けたぞ。
Text (EN): ...Didn't you hear? 【STEEL HEART】 already lost to 【{bad_name}】.

Heading: Rumor 3-3
Text (JP): ルシファー大塚、不動心の龍馬と三人がかりで戦ったんだが、かなわなかったらしい。
Text (EN): 【LUCIFER OTSUKA】, 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】, and him— all three of them fought together, but they still couldn't win.

Heading: Rumor 3-3
Text (JP): なん……だと……。
Text (EN): What the hell...?

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): 最近、随分と慌ただしいよねぇ〜。ん？　ここを主戦場としている走り屋たちのことよ。
Text (EN): Things have been pretty hectic lately, huh? I mean with the racers who make this place their main battleground.

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): ここ何年かは、どのチームも自分たちのスタンスと、縄張りって言うのかな……まぁホームグラウンドが、なんとなくすみ分けられて、全体的に落ち着いてたんだよね。
Text (EN): For the past few years, each team had their own stance and territory— or home turf, I guess you'd call it... Everything was kind of divided up, and things were pretty calm overall.

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): そ・れ・が……観光客の登場で、一気にみんな色めきだっちゃってるのよ。
Text (EN): But then... 【{bad_name}】 shows up, and suddenly everyone's all fired up.

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): まぁ、新しくできたチームも色々あるけどさ。今、ここでトップクラスに君臨してるチームってのはさぁ、もう長いこと、ここを主戦場として走り込んでいるからねぇ〜。
Text (EN): Sure, there are new teams popping up here and there. But the teams ruling at the top level right now? They've been racing these roads as their main battlefield for ages.

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): そこに急に現れた新顔に、あれよあれよという間に負けちゃったんじゃあ、そりゃ面目が立たないよねぇ〜。
Text (EN): So when some new face suddenly appears and beats them before they know what hit them, well, that's gotta hurt their pride, right?

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): 負けちゃったチームの中には、その屈辱を晴らすために、血眼になって観光客を探してるチームもあるみたい。
Text (EN): I heard some of the teams that lost are desperately searching for 【{bad_name}】, trying to get their revenge.

Heading: Rumor 3-4
Text (JP): だ・か・ら……気を付けてね、観光客君。
Text (EN): So... Watch yourself, 【{bad_name}】.

Heading: Rumor 3-5
Text (JP): おにーさん、見っけ～～～っ！！へっへぇ、アタイ知ってんだ。おにーさんが、今、噂の観光客なんでしょ！
Text (EN): Found you, mister! Heh-heh, I know who you are. You're that 【{bad_name}】 everyone's talking about, right?

Heading: Rumor 3-5
Text (JP): SNSに色々上がってたよ～、おにーさんのこと。で、アタイもちょっと会ってみたいなーーーって、ここで待ってたんだぁ。
Text (EN): I saw all kinds of posts about you on social media! So I thought, hey, I wanna meet this guy too—and here I am, waiting for you!

Heading: Rumor 3-5
Text (JP): でさ、砂塵の帝王とー、クレイジーモンキーとーーー、あとダーティーフォックスに勝ったんでしょ？
Text (EN): So, you beat 【SANDSTORM EMPEROR】, and 【CRAZY MONKEY】, and 【DIRTY FOX】 too, right?

Heading: Rumor 3-5
Text (JP): ね、ね、ぶっちゃけさ、誰が一番ショボかった？クレイジーモンキー？　クレイジーモンキーでしょ？　違う？誰にも言わないからさぁ、アタイにだけ教えてよ？
Text (EN): C'mon, c'mon, be real with me—who was the lamest? 【CRAZY MONKEY】? It was 【CRAZY MONKEY】, wasn't it? No? I won't tell anyone, just between you and me?

Heading: Rumor 3-5
Text (JP): ……ふーん、おにーさん、口が堅いんだね。じゃ、とりあえずアタイと2ショット撮ろうよ！カッコよく加工して、SNSに上げとくからさ～。
Text (EN): ...Hmm, you're pretty tight-lipped, mister. Well then, let's at least take a selfie together! I'll edit it to make you look cool and post it on social media.

Heading: Rumor 3-6
Text (JP): 紅童子って案外人気ないのね。
Text (EN): 【CRIMSON BOY】 is surprisingly petty, isn't he?

Heading: Rumor 3-6
Text (JP): 一度負けた相手に、再戦を申し込んだらしいんだけど……。今度は兄弟三人で、次々と襲い掛かったらしいわよ。
Text (EN): I heard he challenged someone who beat him once to a rematch... But this time, he and his two brothers attacked one after another.

Heading: Rumor 3-6
Text (JP): でも、それでも負けちゃったんだって。
Text (EN): But even then, they still lost.

Heading: Rumor 3-6
Text (JP): 紅童子と兄さんたちの金色般若、鉄翁は、この辺では有名な黒崎三兄弟なんだけどね。みんなまとめて負けちゃったんだって。
Text (EN): 【CRIMSON BOY】 and his older brothers 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 and 【IRON OLD MAN】 are the famous around here as the Kurosaki Brothers. But they all lost together.

Heading: Rumor 3-6
Text (JP): なかなかやるじゃない。あなた。
Text (EN): You. Not bad at all.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation

Text (EN): Don't bring up that guy. He got utterly crushed by the ex he once betrayed and can never show his face on the Shuto Expressway again.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation

Text (EN): Hey, hey, did you hear? The rumors about 【{bad_name}】!

Text (JP): バトル中の動画を勝手に撮影してインターネットに載せてるとか、他人のホームページの掲示板を荒らしてるとか。
Text (EN): From recording battle videos without permission and posting them online, and trolling other people's message boards.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-8
Text (JP): その上、バトルした相手にはアドバイスと称して、相手をこき下ろすような陰湿な嫌がらせメールも送ってるらしい。
Text (EN): Plus, he apparently sends nasty harassment emails to his opponents, tearing them down under the guise of giving "advice."

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-8
Text (JP): 最近の若者のネットリテラシーは、どうなってるんだ……？
Text (EN): What's happened to young people's internet literacy these days?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-8
Text (JP): 観光客……。俺、アイツの事応援してたのに……見損なったぜ！
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】... I was rooting for him... But now I've lost all respect!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): ライジングシーマンに愛のトルナード、噂のライターねぇ……。俺が首都環状を離れている間に、聞いたこともない走り屋が幅を効かせるようになったんだな。
Text (EN): 【RISING SEAMAN】, 【TORNADO OF LOVE】, and 【RUMORED WRITER】, huh... Racers I've never even heard of have taken over while I've been away from the Shuto Expressway.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): あなた、トランスドライブやプレイフルジェントルマンのことも知らなかったじゃない。自分の情報収集能力が足りてないだけじゃなくて？
Text (EN): You didn't know about 【TRANCE DRIVE】 or 【PLAYFUL GENTLEMAN】 either. Maybe you're just behind on your intel?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): いやいや、シュワシュワストロングだとかチリツモ戦士なんて変な名前の走り屋、居たら流石に気づくって。
Text (EN): Come on, racers with weird names like 【SHUWA SHUWA STRONG】 or 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】? I'd definitely have noticed them.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): 俺がここを離れていた半年かそこら……そのわずかな間に、新しい実力者が次々と台頭してるんだ。これはなにかの偶然か？
Text (EN): In the six months or so I was gone... In that short time, new powerhouses kept popping up one after another. Is it just coincidence?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): しかも、<Phantom9>の時みたいに、チームとしてまとまった連中ではないみたいだな。
Text (EN): And unlike with 《Phantom9》, they don't seem to be organized as a team.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): ふふ……。やっぱり情報収集能力不足ね。彼らの間には、いろいろ交流があるらしいわよ。
Text (EN): Heehee... Your intel really is lacking. I heard there's quite a bit of interaction between them.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 3-9
Text (JP): ひょっとしたら、私たち……新たな強豪チーム誕生の瞬間を、目撃できるかもしれないわね。
Text (EN): We might just... Witness the birth of a new powerhouse team.

Heading: Rumor 3-10
Text (JP): 久しぶりに首都環状がざわついてるねぇ。
Text (EN): The Shuto Expressway's buzzing for the first time in a while.

Heading: Rumor 3-10
Text (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン、ブラッドハウンド、金色般若が立て続けに負けた時は、その近くの走り屋たちが、ちょっとピリッとしただろ。だが、まだ一部の奴らだけだった。
Text (EN): When 【PLAYFUL GENTLEMAN】, 【BLOODHOUND】, and 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 lost one after another, it put the racers there on edge, if only a few of them.

Heading: Rumor 3-10
Text (JP): だが、最近活躍が目立っていたシュワシュワストロング、チリツモ戦士が敗れ、古参であるミッドナイトローズや鉄翁、闇天狗、そしてユウウツな天使まで負けたとなれば……。
Text (EN): But now that up-and-comers 【SHUWA SHUWA STRONG】 and 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】 have fallen, and veterans like 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】, 【IRON OLD MAN】, 【DARK TENGU】, and even 【MELANCHOLIC ANGEL】 have lost...

Heading: Rumor 3-10
Text (JP): どのチームの奴らも、もうダンマリを決め込むのは無理ってわけだ。
Text (EN): No crew can keep their mouths shut anymore, that's what it means.

Heading: Rumor 3-10
Text (JP): こんなざわつきは、4年ぶりだ。台風の目となってる男は、果たして4年前のアイツと同じようになれるかな？ふふふ……俺は楽しみにしてるよ。
Text (EN): I haven't seen this kind of buzz in four years. Wonder if the guy at the center of it all can live up to what happened four years ago. Heeheehee... I'm looking forward to finding out.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): PAで一息ついていると、人目を引くマシンが目の前を横切って行く。──────NSXだ。
Text (EN): Taking a breather at the parking area, an eye-catching machine crossed your path— an NSX.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 思わず目で追っていると、やがてNSXから降りた男がこちらへと向かって来た。男は、目の前に立ち塞がるようにピタリと足を止める。
Text (EN): Your eyes followed it instinctively, and soon the man who exited the NSX walked toward you. He stopped right in front of you, blocking your way.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): ケケケケ……、どうだ、俺の“S Zero”。イケてるだろ？羨ましいだろ？
Text (EN): Eeheehee... How's my S Zero? Pretty sweet, right? Jealous?

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): あんたのマシンは、ん～っ？　ん～～っ？──────多少はイジってあるみたいだな。ケケケケ……。
Text (EN): Your ride is...hmm? Hmmm? Looks like you've done some mods. Eeheehee...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): まあ、マシンをイジりまわしたところで、肝心のテクニックがついてこなきゃあ……ねえ………？
Text (EN): Well, you can tinker with your machine all you want, but if your skills can't keep up, then, y'know...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): “十三鬼将四天王”の夢見の生霊サマが、ほんとの走りってモンを教えてやろうかぁ？
Text (EN): How 'bout 【Dreaming Spirit】 of the THIRTEEN DEVILS Four Heavenly Kings teaches you what real driving's all about?

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 反応に窮していたところ、さらに3人の走り屋が現れた。シャドウアイズ、追撃のテイルガンナー、ダイングスターと名乗る3人は、夢見の生霊の語る“四天王”のメンバーであるようだ。
Text (EN): While struggling to respond, three more street racers appeared. They introduced themselves as 【SHADOW EYES】, 【PURSUING TAILGUNNER】, and 【DYING STAR】, and they seemed to be members of the Four Heavenly Kings that 【Dreaming Spirit】 mentioned.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): やめな、そういう絡み方。誰も頼んでないんだよ。あとキモイ笑い方もやめろ。
Text (EN): Cut it out with that crap. Nobody asked you to do it. And quit that creepy laugh while you're at it.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Character (JP): 追撃のテイルガンナー
Text (JP): 君の陰湿な性格は最早フォローのしようもないが、僕たちまで同類だと、彼に思われては困るからね。
Text (EN): Your nasty personality is beyond saving at this point, but I can't have him thinking we're all like you.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 第一、もう十三鬼将は解散したからな……。いつまでも名乗ってるの、ダサいだろ……。
Text (EN): Besides, the THIRTEEN DEVILS disbanded already, and yet you're still going by that name? That's just lame...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): あン？んな似合ってねぇサングラス得意げにかけてるような奴にダセェとか言われたくねえよ。
Text (EN): Huh? I ain't takin' fashion advice from some poser who thinks those ugly shades look cool.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): ううッ……。心にくる……。こ、これは……。……目つぶし攻撃を防ぐために……。うう……。
Text (EN): Ugh, that hurts... Th-These are... to protect against blinding attacks... Ugh...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 似合ってないのは確かだわ。でも、今そんなことはどうでもいいの。
Text (EN): They definitely don't suit you. But that's not what matters right now.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 観光客。アタシたちとバトルしなさい。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】. You're racing us.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): 結構長い間、首都環状を留守にしてたけど……いつのまにか面白くないことになってるじゃないの。
Text (EN): We've been away from the Shuto Expressway for quite a while... And things have gotten pretty boring around here.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Character (JP): 追撃のテイルガンナー
Text (JP): ブラッドハウンドの奴と久しぶりに話したが……君を迅帝の再来だとか言っていた。ともに十三鬼将を名乗っていた元・同志ではあるが、共感はできないな。
Text (EN): I talked to 【BLOODHOUND】 for the first time in ages... He was calling you the second coming of the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】. We may have been comrades in the THIRTEEN DEVILS once, but I can't agree with that.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): うう……。迅帝は、オレたちの“黄金時代”なんだ……。
Text (EN): Ugh... The 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 was our golden era...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): アタシたちの認める“伝説”は、たった一人だけ。そして──────彼のライバルに相応しいのはこのアタシ。
Text (EN): There's only one legend we recognize. And I'm the only one worthy of being his rival.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Character (JP): 追撃のテイルガンナー
Text (JP): いや、それはこの僕だ。
Text (EN): No, that would be me.

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): オレ……。
Text (EN): Me...

Heading: Four Heavenly Kings of the Thirteen Devils
Text (JP): ま、そ〜ゆ〜色々を、今から新人クンに教えてあげようってことさ。ケケケケ……。当然、やるよなぁ？ 新世代の走り屋さんよぉ。
Text (EN): Well, we're gonna teach the rookie here all about that stuff. Eeheehee... You're up for it, right, next-gen racer?

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): バトルを終えてPAに戻ると、見覚えのあるマシンを見つけた。首都環状の夜景に映える、鮮やかな黄色のRX-8。12時過ぎのシンデレラだ。
Text (EN): After the battle, back at the parking area, a familiar machine caught my eye— a vibrant yellow RX-8 that stood out against the Shuto Expressway night view. It was 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): こんばんは、いい夜ね。しばらく会わない間に随分と腕を上げたみたいじゃない。元・十三鬼将の連中も形無しね。
Text (EN): Good evening. Beautiful night, isn't it? Looks like you've gotten a lot better since we last met. Even the former THIRTEEN DEVILS don't stand a chance.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): アンタは私を倒したんだから、そうでなくちゃ、納得がいかないわ。
Text (EN): You beat me, after all. Anything less wouldn't sit right with me.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): ……前に話したこと、覚えてる？アンタには“煌き”がある――――光のように眩く熱い気持ち。私は、それが迅帝に挑むための“資格”だと思ってる。
Text (EN): ...Remember what I told you before? You have that "Radiance"—a feeling as dazzling and hot as light itself. I think that's what qualifies you to challenge the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 「もっと走りたい！」っていうワクワクした気持ちを呼び起こしてくれる人。心のエンジンに火を入れてくれる人――――。今の迅帝には、そういう“ライバル”が必要だと思う……。
Text (EN): Someone who awakens that excited "I want to race more!" feeling. Someone who ignites the engine in your heart... I think the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 needs a rival like that right now...

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 迅帝について何か知っているのか？12時過ぎのシンデレラに問いかけようとした、その時。
Text (EN): Did 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】 know something about the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】? Just as I was about to ask her...

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 金色に輝く機体が、PA中の衆目を集めながら颯爽と現れる。その中から降りてきたのは、愛機にも引けを取らない、派手な出で立ちの男だった。
Text (EN): A golden machine appeared with flair, drawing every eye in the parking area. The man who stepped out was just as flashy as his ride.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): あら？宮川クンじゃない。久しぶりね、何か御用かしら？
Text (EN): Oh? If it isn't Miyagawa-kun. Long time no see. What brings you here?

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 君を笑いに来た……そう言えば、君の気が済むのだろう？
Text (EN): I came to mock you... That's what you want to hear, right?

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): ……。相変わらず人生楽しそうね、見てると元気出るわ。赤いに乗るのはやめちゃったの？
Text (EN): ... Still living it up, I see. Makes me feel better just watching you. Not driving red anymore?

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 何色の機体に乗ろうが、私は紅の悪魔だ。それ以上でもそれ以下でもない――私は、そこの青年に話があって来たのだ。
Text (EN): Whatever color I drive, I am the 【CRIMSON DEVIL】. Nothing more, nothing less. I came here to speak with that young man.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): 観光客よ。迅帝に挑まんとする君が、この紅の悪魔に勝てないなどとは言うまいな。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】. You who would challenge the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】... surely you won't say you can't beat the 【CRIMSON DEVIL】?

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): ――見せてもらおうか。首都環状を騒がす新鋭の走りとやらを。
Text (EN): Show me. Let me see this new talent that's got the Shuto Expressway buzzing.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-1
Text (JP): ……自分も観光客とバトルがしたい、って言ってるわ。ま、アンタなら心配いらないわね。頑張って！
Text (EN): ...He's saying he wants to race 【{bad_name}】 too. Well, I'm not worried about you. Go get 'em!

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): これが若さか……。
Text (EN): So this is what youth feels like...

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): ふっ……感謝する。いいバトルだった。
Text (EN): Heh... My thanks. That was a good battle.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): ――君は、“最強の存在”となった自分をイメージできるか？その栄光の陰にあるのは孤独だ。癒えることのない渇き――。
Text (EN): Can you imagine yourself as the "strongest"? Behind that glory lies solitude. An unquenchable thirst...

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): ……4年前、ある男が当時の首都環状のすべての走り屋を倒し、頂点に立った。
Text (EN): ...Four years ago, a man defeated every street racer on the Shuto Expressway and stood at the top.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): 新たな伝説を作り上げたその男は、闘う相手を……“ライバル”を失った。それゆえ、さらなるSTAGEを求め、師と共に首都環状を去ったのだ。
Text (EN): Having forged a new legend, that man lost what he needed most— his rivals. And so, seeking an even greater stage, he left the Shuto Expressway with his mentor.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): ――認められるものか。どうして、勝ち逃げなど許せようか？闘う相手が必要だというのなら、何度でも立ちはだかってやろう。
Text (EN): I can't accept that. How can I let him just walk away victorious? If he needs someone to fight, I'll stand in his way again and again.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): 我々は……かつての迅帝を知る走り屋たちは、奴の心に再び火をつけようとしているのだ。それぞれのやり方でな。
Text (EN): We... the racers who remember the old 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 are trying to reignite the fire in his heart. Each in our own way.

Heading: The Dashing Crimson Devil-2
Text (JP): ――迅帝に挑まんとする、新世代の挑戦者よ。その資格となる闘志の火種は、君の魂の中にも煌いているようだ。
Text (EN): A next-gen challenger who dares face the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】... I can see that spark of fighting spirit radiating within your soul as well.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): PAでマシンから降りると、裕福そうな白人の男に声をかけられた。アクセントに多少の訛りはあるものの、聞き取りやすい流暢な日本語だ。
Text (EN): After stepping out of the car at the parking area, a wealthy-looking white man approached me. Despite a slight accent, his Japanese was fluent and easy to understand.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): あなたが観光客ですね？<Phantom9>のほとんどのメンバーを撃墜した実力者だとか。
Text (EN): So you're 【{bad_name}】, aren't you? The powerhouse who's taken down most of 《Phantom9》's members.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): いずれスネークアイズとも対決するつもりなのでしょう？……ならば、私たちは目的を共有する仲間たりうるのです。
Text (EN): You're planning to face 【SNAKE EYES】 eventually, right? Then we share the same goal. We could be allies.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): 私が初めて首都環状を訪れたのは、スネークアイズにリベンジマッチを挑むためでした。
Text (EN): When I first came to the Shuto Expressway, it was to challenge 【SNAKE EYES】 to a rematch.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): ──失礼、ご挨拶がまだでしたね。私はジェイムズ・ビギンズ……首都環状での名はスカールバレット。それなりに名の知れたHASHIRIYAなんですヨ。
Text (EN): Oh, forgive me. I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm James Beggins... known on the Shuto Expressway as 【SKULL BULLET】. I'm quite a well-known HASHIRIYA, you know.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): しかし、私のホームグラウンドはビジネスの世界にあります。貴方も聞いた事がありませんか？最近は、日本でも“ビギンズ・グループ”のオーナーとして知られているんです。
Text (EN): But my true arena is the business world. Haven't you heard? These days, I'm known in Japan as the owner of the Beggins Group.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): 私は、首都環状には大きなビジネスチャンスがあると考えています。
Text (EN): I believe the Shuto Expressway holds tremendous business potential.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): やり方次第で、世界中から人が、企業が、カネが集まる。人々は私の箱庭でスピードに熱狂し、勝利の栄光に浴する。HASHIRIYAたちの楽園が築かれる──。
Text (EN): Done right, it could draw people, corporations, and money from around the world. They'll come to my playground, get drunk on speed, and bask in victory's glory. A paradise for HASHIRIYA will be born...

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): いかがですか？私の配下となれば、あらゆる栄華を手にすることができるでしょう。
Text (EN): What do you say? Join me, and you'll have access to every luxury imaginable.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): …………ふむ。あまり興味がないようですネ。残念です。
Text (EN): ...Hmm. You don't seem very interested. That's unfortunate.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): 利用価値がないのなら、排除するのみ。危険の芽は若いうちに摘んでおく、それが私のモットーです。
Text (EN): If you have no value to me, then you must be eliminated. Nip danger in the bud while it's young—that's my motto.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-1
Text (JP): まずは私の仲間たち──紺碧のスナイパー、沈黙のカシオペア、夜明けのガーネット。彼らを破ってごらんナサイ。
Text (EN): First, try defeating my associates: 【DEEP BLUE SNIPER】, 【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】, and 【DAWN GARNET】.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): Excellent! これほどの実力をお持ちとは。やはりあなたのような傑物を捨て置くのは惜しい。
Text (EN): Excellent! To possess such skill... It would truly be a waste to let someone of your caliber slip away.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): それほどの実力があれば、私の築く“楽園”で、名誉もカネも、全てが思うままになるでしょう。もう一度、考えてみることを勧めますが――――
Text (EN): With abilities like yours, everything—honor, money, all of it— would be yours for the taking in my paradise. I suggest you reconsider...

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): その時。別の男が現れ、スカールバレットの言葉を遮った。もう若くはないが、走り屋らしい壮健さを備えた、風格のある男だ。
Text (EN): Just then, another man appeared, cutting off 【SKULL BULLET】's words. No longer young, but with the robust vigor of a street racer, he carried himself with dignity.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): そこまでだ……スカールバレット。観光客は、お前さんの騙る“楽園”とやらには興味がなさそうだぜ。
Text (EN): That's enough, 【SKULL BULLET】. 【{bad_name}】 doesn't seem interested in your so-called paradise.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): それに……お前さんに賛同する奴は、この首都環状にはいないだろうよ。ここは“最速”を求める魂たちが作り上げる舞台……よそ者が金儲けするための場所じゃない。
Text (EN): Besides, you won't find anyone on the Shuto Expressway who'll side with you. This is a stage built by souls seeking to be the "fastest"... Not some playground for outsiders to make a quick buck.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): 敗者らしく、おとなしく引き下がるんだな……。
Text (EN): Like a proper loser, you should just quietly back down...

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): おやおや、これはおかしな話だ。あなた方<Phantom9>も、この首都環状においてはよそ者。侵略者でしょう。
Text (EN): Well, well, how amusing. You 《Phantom9》 are outsiders on this Shuto Expressway too. Invaders, in fact.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): ……ああ、貴方だけは違うのでしたネ。未明の時代を駆け抜けた、生ける伝説パープルメテオ……。
Text (EN): ...Oh, but you're different, aren't you? The living legend who raced through the dawn of an era, 【PURPLE METEOR】...

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): 悪いが、今の俺は<Phantom9>のNAMAHAGEだ。スネークアイズの命に従い、観光客を討ち取りに来た。
Text (EN): Sorry, but right now I'm 【NAMAHAGE】 of 《Phantom9》. Following 【SNAKE EYES】' orders, I've come to take down 【{bad_name}】.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): まんまとお前の手駒に加えさせるわけにはいかない。邪魔をするなら……俺が相手になろう。
Text (EN): I won't just let you add me to your collection of pawns. If you're going to get in my way... I'll be your opponent.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): ……敗者は黙って立ち去るとしましょう。今日のところはね。
Text (EN): The loser will depart in silence... For today, at least.

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): ――さァて。
Text (EN): Now then—

Heading: Bullet Marks in Paradise-2
Text (JP): 観光客。長ったらしい前口上を述べるつもりはない。勝負といこうや。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】. I'm not one for long-winded speeches. Let's settle this on the road.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): フ……やるな。俺の負けだ。
Text (EN): Heh... Not bad. You got me.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): いよいよスネークアイズが直接、お前さんを狙ってくることだろう。奴は、新世代の寵児であるお前さんを倒すことで実力を証明し、“最強の挑戦者”として迅帝に挑むつもりだ。
Text (EN): 【SNAKE EYES】 will be coming for you directly now. He plans to prove his worth by defeating you, the rising star of the new generation, and take on 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 as the ultimate challenger.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): それだけが、今のスネークアイズの走る理由――――。先代に才能を見いだされ、走りの世界で生きる方法を教わった小僧が、<Phantom9>という武器を与えられた時の条件――――。
Text (EN): That's the only reason 【SNAKE EYES】 races now— The condition set when that kid, discovered by his predecessor and taught how to survive in the racing world, was given 《Phantom9》 as his weapon.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): すなわち、奴の行動原理そのもの。スネークアイズは迅帝を倒すことでしか、己の価値を証明できないのさ。
Text (EN): In other words, it's the very principle of his actions. 【SNAKE EYES】 can only prove his worth by defeating 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): 哀れなヤツさ……。いつの時代も、若者ってェのは悩み多く、繊細で、不器用なモンだな。
Text (EN): Poor bastard... In every era, young folks are full of worries, sensitive, and clumsy.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): アイツも……俺の弟子もそうだった。悩みながら、迷いながら、「スピードだけがたった一つの真実」と信じてただひたすらに走り続けてきた。
Text (EN): They were like that too... My apprentice. Struggling, wavering, believing that "speed is the only truth," they just kept racing on and on.

Heading: Shooting Down the Meteor
Text (JP): 因縁の先に何があるのか――――。舞台袖から、見届けさせてもらうとするか。
Text (EN): Whatever lies beyond this fateful encounter... I'll watch from the sidelines.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): PAを歩いていると、チリツモ戦士とシュワシュワストロングに偶然出会った。さらに、周囲には見知った顔ぶれが集まっている。
Text (EN): Walking through the parking area, you happened to run into 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】 and 【SHUWA SHUWA STRONG】. Even more familiar faces had gathered around.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): よお、観光客。久しぶりだな。
Text (EN): Yo, 【{bad_name}】. It's been a while.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Character (JP): シュワシュワストロング
Text (JP): オウッ！炭酸足りてるか？お前は特別だ、2本やる。
Text (EN): Oh yeah! Got enough carbonation? You're special, take two.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): アニキ……。2Lもあるデカいペットボトル、急に渡されても困るって……。しかも2本……。
Text (EN): Bro... Nobody knows what to do with a huge two-liter bottle suddenly shoved at them... Not to mention a pair of them...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): ボンソワール！ ブエノス・ノーチェス！ また来て次週！どうもどうも、お噂はかねがね！最近ますますご活躍のようですね。
Text (EN): Bonsoir! Buenos noches! See you next week! Well, well, I've heard all about you! Seems you're more active than ever lately.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): なんでも、新人の走り屋を叩きのめして再起不能にしたとか……？見かけによらず、おっかないんですねぇ……。
Text (EN): I heard you beat down some rookie street racer so bad they can't race anymore? You're scarier than you look...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): なんて、冗談、冗談。アナタがそんな人ではないことは、よーくわかっていますよ。
Text (EN): Kidding, just kidding! I know very well you're not that kind of person.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): ふふ、そういうこと。安心して、みんなわかってるから……。つまらない噂だわ。
Text (EN): Hehe, exactly. Don't worry, everyone knows... It's just a stupid rumor.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): ……あ、あのっ。私たち、これから湾岸線のあたりを一緒に走るんですけど……。良かったら、あなたも……一緒にどうですか？
Text (EN): Um, excuse me... We're about to go race around the Bayshore Line together. Would you like to... join us?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリスちゃんと知り合って、お話しして……気づいたんです。独り立ちするっていうのは、一人きりで行動するってことじゃなくて……。自分の居場所を、自分で決めることなんだね……って。
Text (EN): Getting to know 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, talking with her... I realized something. Standing on your own doesn't mean acting all alone... It means deciding where you belong... By yourself.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): 俺たちはチームに入ってねぇから、大勢で走る機会は滅多にないんだが、前から興味があったんだ。
Text (EN): We ain't in a team, so we rarely get chances to race in big groups, but I've always been curious about it.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): 日頃の俺は “運命のレディ” を探して、首都環状をさすらう旅人だが……時にはこんな風にダチとつるんで、心の隙間を埋めるのも悪くねえ。
Text (EN): Usually I'm a wanderer cruising the Shuto Expressway in search of my "destined lady"... But sometimes hanging with buddies like this to fill the void ain't bad either.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): 湾岸の “風” が言いよーと。今夜は最高んバトルがでくる！
Text (EN): The Bayshore wind's speakin' to me. Tonight's gonna be one hell of a battle!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): バトルを通じて出会った彼らの間には、いつからか友情が芽生えていたようだ。チリツモ戦士は少し照れくさそうに、しかし心から嬉しそうに笑った。
Text (EN): Through their battles, a friendship had blossomed between them. 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】 smiled, a bit bashfully but genuinely happy.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): 皆と一緒に走ってたら、すっごく楽しくてさ……。ひとりで色々考えて悩んでたのがばかばかしく思えてきたんだ。
Text (EN): Racing with everyone is so much fun... All that time I spent worrying alone seems so stupid now.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): アニキの言う通り――――走りたいから走る。それだけでいいんだよなって。
Text (EN): Just like bro says—we race because we want to race. That's all there is to it.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Let's Run Because We Want To
Text (JP): な、あんたも来いよ。湾岸線で待ってるぜ。
Text (EN): Hey, you should come too. We'll be waiting at the Bayshore Line.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): チリツモ戦士たちと別れ、PAでしばし休息をとっていると、すっかり見慣れた顔の2人組に声をかけられた。
Text (EN): After parting with 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】 and the others, taking a break at the parking area, you were approached by a familiar duo.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): その顔立ちと背格好、服の趣味、車の趣味、瞬きひとつする仕草さえよく似ている双子の兄弟――ルーレット野郎1号とルーレット野郎2号だ。
Text (EN): Their faces, builds, fashion sense, taste in cars— even the way they blinked was nearly identical. They were twin brothers— 【ROULETTE GUY NO. 1】 and 【ROULETTE GUY NO. 2】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): やあ！見てたぜ、さっきの大規模チェインバトル。
Text (EN): Hey there! We saw it—that massive chain battle just now.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): サイコーだったな、抜きつ抜かれつのデッドヒート。キレイにつながった8台のマシン――。湾岸線の走り屋みんながくぎ付けさ。
Text (EN): It was insane! That back-and-forth dead heat. Eight machines linked up in perfect formation— Every street racer on the Bayshore was glued to it.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): それにしても、最近は彼らがつるんでいるところをよく見かけるな。一部は元から仲が良さそうだったけど、気が付いたら随分と大所帯になってるじゃないか。
Text (EN): You know, we've been seeing them hanging out together a lot lately. Some of them seemed tight from the start, but man, they've grown into quite the crew now.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): なんでも久遠のポラリスを中心にまとまってきたらしいぜ。
Text (EN): Word is they've all come together around 【ETERNAL POLARIS】.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): へえ……あの無口な子が？そんな社会性を持ってたとは、意外だな。俺たち、未だにぜんぜん話してもらえないけどね。
Text (EN): Really? That quiet kid? Never thought she had that kind of social streak. We still can't get her to talk to us at all.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): 龍士が軽薄そうなカオしてるのがいけないんじゃないか？
Text (EN): Maybe it's 'cause Ryuji has that sleazy-looking face?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): 武虎も同じカオだろ。それに観光客だって、ロクに会話の続いたためしがないらしいぜ。
Text (EN): Taketora's got the same face, dude. Besides, even 【{bad_name}】 apparently can't hold a conversation with her either.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): そりゃ御愁傷様。それで、今日のチェインバトルには、肝心の久遠のポラリスは参加してたのか？
Text (EN): You have my condolences. So, was 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 herself in today's chain battle?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): ふーん……やっぱりいなかったんだ。最近、彼女を全然見かけなくなったよ。
Text (EN): Huh... So she wasn't there after all. We haven't seen her around at all lately.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): PAにも来ていないみたいだし。あのコのR33を最後に見たのは、いつだったかな。
Text (EN): She hasn't been coming to the parking area either. When was the last time we saw that girl's R33?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Guided by the Spark
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリスほどの走り屋なら、どこにいても目立ちそうなものだけどな――。
Text (EN): A street racer like 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 should stand out no matter where she goes...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): PAでセッティングを詰めていると、先ほどバトルした2台のマシンがPAに入ってくるのが見えた。マシンから降りてきた2人組は、すさまじい剣幕でこちらに迫って来る。
Text (EN): While fine-tuning settings at the parking area, I spotted the two machines from the earlier battle pulling in. The pair that emerged stormed toward me with murderous intensity.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): 1人は、やや古風な印象を受けるが、硬派で実直そうな男、一徹ストレート。もう1人は、華やかな容姿に芯の通った強さを感じさせる女、マネードリームだ。しかし今、2人の目には激しい怒りが燃えていた。
Text (EN): One was 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】—a somewhat old-fashioned but solid, upright guy. The other was 【MONEY DREAM】—a gorgeous woman with an iron core of strength. But now, both their eyes blazed with furious rage.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): いい気なものね、観光客！
Text (EN): You've got some nerve, 【{bad_name}】!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): 今回は遅れを取ったが……てめェは俺が必ず潰してやる。この卑怯モンが！
Text (EN): I may have lost today... But I'll crush you for sure, You coward!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): ……あ？ 何しらばっくれてんだ！ネタは上がってるんだぜ。
Text (EN): Huh...? Don't play dumb! We've got the dirt on you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): てめェが久遠のポラリスを呼び出した上で、危険走行を仕掛けたって証言してる奴がいンだよ！
Text (EN): We've got witnesses saying you called out 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 and pulled dangerous moves on her!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): 幸い、彼女自身は大きなケガもなく、無事だったらしいけど……許せないわ。
Text (EN): Thankfully, she wasn't seriously hurt and made it out okay... But it's unforgivable.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): クルマへの愛情も、乗り手へのリスペクトもないのね。このッ……サイテー野郎！
Text (EN): You have no love for cars, no respect for drivers... You're an absolute scumbag!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): 次は今日のようにはいかねぇからな。首を洗って待っていやがれ！
Text (EN): Next time won't go like today. You better watch your back!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): 2人はこちらが反論する猶予も与えず、怒りに任せてまくしたてると、それぞれのマシンに乗り込みPAを出て行った。
Text (EN): Without giving me a chance to defend myself, they unleashed their fury in a torrent of words, then jumped in their machines and tore out of the parking area.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): ……自分が久遠のポラリスに危険走行を仕掛けた？謂れのない噂を立てられるのには慣れてきたが、これは度を越している。
Text (EN): ...I pulled dangerous moves on 【ETERNAL POLARIS】? I'd gotten used to baseless rumors, but this crossed the line.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Target of Malice
Text (JP): しかし――危険走行があったことは事実なのか？……久遠のポラリス。彼女は今、どうしているのだろうか――。
Text (EN): But was there really dangerous driving involved? ...【ETERNAL POLARIS】. What was happening with her now?

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): 伝説も、外道も、新鋭も、知ったことかーーーーー
Text (EN): Legends, scoundrels, newcomers—to hell with all of them────

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): 誰が一番速い？
Text (EN): Who is the fastest?

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): それ以外に何の意味があるって言うんだ
Text (EN): What other meaning could there possibly be?

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): 夜の環状線を彷徨う無数の魂たちが
Text (EN): The countless souls wandering the expressway at night

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): 狂おしいほどに渇望する栄光と孤高の境地
Text (EN): Madly thirst for that realm of glory and solitude

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): ーーーーー“最速”
Text (EN): ────"The Fastest"

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): その称号を手にした者は、時代の先導者となる
Text (EN): Whoever claims that title becomes the vanguard of the era

Heading: Interlude: Burning With Madness
Text (JP): たとえそれを望まずとも
Text (EN): Even if they never wished for it

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): おい、大変だ！元・“十三鬼将” 四天王が首都環状に帰って来たぜ！こりゃぁ迅帝の復活という噂もガセじゃなさそうだな。
Text (EN): Yo, this is huge! The former Four Heavenly Kings of the THIRTEEN DEVILS are back on the Shuto Expressway! Guess those rumors about 【SWIFT EMPEROR】's return weren't just hot air after all.

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): 流石の観光客も、彼らにはかなわないだろうぜ。ざまぁ見やがれってんだ！
Text (EN): Even the mighty 【{bad_name}】 won't stand a chance against them. Serves 'em right!

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): ずいぶん“十三鬼将”に肩入れするんだな。何か理由があるのか？
Text (EN): You're really rooting for the THIRTEEN DEVILS, huh. Any particular reason?

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): お、俺は迅帝や“十三鬼将”に憧れて走り屋になったんだ。それなのに、ぽっと出の若い野郎に負けたなんて……、悔しくないはずがないだろうが！
Text (EN): I-I became a racer because I looked up to 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 and the THIRTEEN DEVILS. But now that they've lost to some nobody who came out of nowhere... How could I not be pissed?!

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): ふうん。まぁ、わからなくはないがな。だが、“十三鬼将”だって、初めはぽっと出だったんじゃないのか？
Text (EN): Hmm. Well, I get where you're coming from. But the THIRTEEN DEVILS started as nobodies too, right?

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): それに迅帝がデビューした時だって、今の観光客みたいな鮮烈さだったらしいぞ。“いつも突然、現れる”――――ってさ。
Text (EN): Plus when 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 debuted, he apparently had the same explosive impact as 【{bad_name}】 does now. "Always appearing out of nowhere," they say.

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): ち……違い違い！迅帝は観光客より、もっともーっとすごかったんだい！
Text (EN): N-No way! 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 was way, WAY more amazing than 【{bad_name}】!

Heading: Rumor 4-1
Text (JP): やれやれ、熱心なファンがいたもんだ。まぁ、これだけ応援してもらえれば、走り屋冥利に尽きるってもんか？
Text (EN): Well well, looks like he's got a devoted fan. With support like that, I guess being a racer pays off, huh?

Heading: Rumor 4-2
Text (JP): 元・“十三鬼将” 四天王のそろい踏みには、さすがに興奮するが……“十三鬼将”の全員は揃わないようだな。
Text (EN): The former Four Heavenly Kings of the THIRTEEN DEVILS all showing up together is definitely exciting... But it looks like the full THIRTEEN DEVILS won't be reuniting.

Heading: Rumor 4-2
Text (JP): “十二覇聖”も同じようなものだ。一部は名を変えて<Be Legend>のメンバーとなっているが、当時の“十二覇聖”全員が揃う事は無いだろう。
Text (EN): Same goes for The ZODIAC. Some have changed their names and joined 《Be Legend》, but the full original ZODIAC lineup will never come together again.

Heading: Rumor 4-2
Text (JP): まぁ、伝説ってのはそんなものだ。「どうせまた会える」なんてのは、第三者の勝手な希望でしかない。
Text (EN): Well, that's how legends work. "We'll definitely meet again someday" is just wishful thinking from outsiders.

Heading: Rumor 4-2
Text (JP): だからこそ、“今”を十分その目に焼き付けるべきなんだ。俺は首都環状の歴史を、そうやって見守り続けてきたのさ。
Text (EN): That's exactly why you need to burn what's happening now into your memory. That's how I've kept watch over the history of the Shuto Expressway.

Heading: Rumor 4-3
Text (JP): 君さぁ、ちょっとやりすぎだよぉ〜。紅の悪魔にまで勝っちゃうなんて、ちょっとやりすぎだぞ。
Text (EN): You know, you're going a biiit overboard. Beating even 【CRIMSON DEVIL】? That's taking it too far.

Heading: Rumor 4-3
Text (JP): でもさぁ〜君がここまでやるとは、さすがの私でも思ってなかったよ。
Text (EN): But stiiill... Even I didn't expect you to go this far.

Heading: Rumor 4-3
Text (JP): もし、このまま勝ち進んでいくと、いずれあの男……迅帝と会うかもね。
Text (EN): If you keep winning like this, you might eventually meet that man... 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Rumor 4-3
Text (JP): ふふふ……こんな騒ぎは、4年ぶりかなぁ。ちょっとワクワクしてるかも。じゃあね。
Text (EN): Heeheehee... Haven't seen this kind of commotion in four years. I'm getting a little excited. See ya.

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): あのスカールバレットが、観光客に目を付けたそうだ。どうやら、新たな配下のひとりとして、手勢に加えたがっているらしい。
Text (EN): Word is 【SKULL BULLET】 has his eye on 【{bad_name}】. Seems he wants to recruit them as one of his new underlings.

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): 奴の配下といえば……沈黙のカシオペア、紺碧のスナイパー、そして夜明けのガーネットの3人。
Text (EN): His current crew consists of... 【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】, 【DEEP BLUE SNIPER】, and 【DAWN GARNET】.

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): 走り屋として実力者であるだけでなく、ビジネスでも利害関係を結んでいるから、結束が固い。対立する<Phantom9>に比べて、奴らの優位性はそこにある。
Text (EN): They're not just skilled racers; they're bound by business interests too, which makes them tight-knit. That's their advantage over the rival 《Phantom9》.

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): そんな中に加えようとしているってことは……観光客に対しても、何かの価値を見出しているんだろうか？
Text (EN): If he's trying to bring in someone new... Does that mean he sees some kind of value in 【{bad_name}】?

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): さあな。スカールバレットの頭の中に、どんな壮大な計画が描かれているのかは、凡人には窺い知るすべもないが……。
Text (EN): Who knows. Whatever grand scheme 【SKULL BULLET】 has cooking in that head of his is beyond what us ordinary folks can comprehend...

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): 奴は先代のスネークアイズにリベンジするためだけに、はるばるアメリカから追いかけてきたという、執念深い男だ。
Text (EN): The guy's so obsessed he followed the previous 【SNAKE EYES】 all the way from America just to get his revenge.

Heading: Rumor 4-4
Text (JP): そんな奴に目をつけられるとは……観光客は、これから厄介なことに巻き込まれていきそうだな。
Text (EN): Getting targeted by someone like that... 【{bad_name}】 is about to get caught up in some serious trouble.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): ……ったく、一体何だってんだよぉ〜。あの男、人のことを捕まえるなり「スネークアイズを見たか？」って、えらい剣幕で。
Text (EN): ...What the hell was that all about? That guy just grabs me and goes, "Have you seen 【SNAKE EYES】?" All aggressive and in my face.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): 知らないって答えたら、「じゃあ、用はねぇ」って、ゴメンも無しだぜ。ったく、ガラが悪いなぁ〜。
Text (EN): When I told him I didn't know, he just goes, "Then you're no use to me," and he walks off. Not even an apology! Talk about bad manners.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): 後ろにいた別の男は、虫けらでも見るような冷たい目でじっと睨んでくるし……もう一人いた姉ちゃんは、えらい美人だったけどなぁ。
Text (EN): And that other guy behind him kept staring at me with these cold eyes, like I was some kind of insect... Though I gotta say, the girl with them was a real beauty.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): 兄ちゃん、災難だったな。あいつは紺碧のスナイパー……後ろにいた2人は沈黙のカシオペアと夜明けのガーネットだな。スカールバレット一派の三人組さ。
Text (EN): Tough break, buddy. That was 【DEEP BLUE SNIPER】... The two behind him were 【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】 and 【DAWN GARNET】. The three of them run with 【SKULL BULLET】's crew.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): え？ おじさん、あの人たちのこと知ってるんですか？ホント、もう失礼な奴らですよ。
Text (EN): Huh? You know those people, mister? Man, they were seriously rude.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): 彼らは、4年前にスカールバレットが連れてきた仲間だ。単にスカールバレットの言いなりになってるわけじゃなく、どうやら彼ら自身にも、<Phantom9>との因縁があるらしい。
Text (EN): They're the crew 【SKULL BULLET】 brought in four years ago. They're not just following 【SKULL BULLET】's orders though— apparently they've got their own score to settle with 《Phantom9》.

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): でも当時、肝心のスネークアイズが消息を絶っちまったもんで、連中の姿もすっかり見かけなくなっていたんだが……。
Text (EN): But back then, 【SNAKE EYES】 himself went off the grid, so we stopped seeing those guys around too...

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): え？ ボクはさっきスネークアイズについて尋ねられましたけど。消息を絶っているんですよね？
Text (EN): Wait, but they just asked me about 【SNAKE EYES】. You said he disappeared, right?

Heading: Rumor 4-5
Text (JP): だからさ……。恐らく、戻ってきているんだ。罪作りのあの男がね。
Text (EN): That's just it... He's probably back. That troublemaker.

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): おい、聞いたか？観光客が、ついにNAMAHAGEまでも撃墜したらしい。
Text (EN): Hey, you hear? 【{bad_name}】 finally took down 【NAMAHAGE】 too.

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): マジかよっ！？それじゃあ<Phantom9>の連中、今頃大騒ぎになってるんじゃないか？
Text (EN): Are you serious?! Then the 《Phantom9》 crew must be going crazy right about now!

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): まさにその通り。「やっぱりサブリーダーに相応しいのは自分だ。チーム内の上下関係をハッキリさせる」……ってなことをクレイジーモンキーが言い出したのを皮切りに、
Text (EN): You got that right. 【CRAZY MONKEY】 started it off by claiming he's the one who deserves to be sub-leader and that they need to establish a clear hierarchy...

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): 「迅帝に会えるっていうから再結集の誘いに乗ったのに、こんな体たらくならこっちから<Phantom9>を見限ってやる」……なんてことを闇天狗が言ったとか、ビビってすぐ撤回したとか。
Text (EN): Then 【DARK TENGU】 goes and says something like, "I only came back because they promised I'd meet 【SWIFT EMPEROR】. If this is how it's gonna be, I'll abandon 《Phantom9》 myself." Though I heard he chickened out and took it back real quick.

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): つまり観光客に敗北したことをきっかけに、チーム内で食った食われたのポジション争いが激化しているらしい。かえって士気が上がっているとか……。
Text (EN): Point is, losing to 【{bad_name}】 has kicked off a dog-eat-dog power struggle inside the team. They say morale's actually gone up because of it...

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): ふーん、意外とハングリー精神旺盛な連中なんだな。2代目スネークアイズとか、「<Phantom9>に弱者は不要だ」みたいなこと、いかにも言いそうな……なんか冷徹なイメージだけど。
Text (EN): Huh, so they're hungrier than I thought. That second generation 【SNAKE EYES】 seems like the type who'd say, "《Phantom9》 has no room for the weak," or something... He's got that cold, ruthless image.

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): 2代目スネークアイズか……確かに、シビアなリーダーではあるだろう。アメリカでは過激なドラッグレースに身を投じ、当局にマークされていたらしいからな……。
Text (EN): The second 【SNAKE EYES】, huh... He's definitely a tough leader. I heard he threw himself into extreme drag races in America and got himself on the authorities' radar...

Heading: Rumor 4-6
Text (JP): だが一度や二度の敗北でメンバーを見限るような精神性の持ち主なら、新生<Phantom9>を束ねることはできないだろうさ。そういうところが、先代に選ばれた理由なんじゃないのか？
Text (EN): But if he was the type to abandon members after one or two losses, he couldn't hold the new 《Phantom9》 together. Maybe that's exactly why the first generation chose him as successor?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-7
Text (JP): 最近出しゃばってるチーム、あの<CLUB GARUDA>の奴ら、なんなのよぉ！ ホントッ！
Text (EN): That crew that's been throwing their weight around lately, those 《CLUB GARUDA》 punks, what the hell is their problem?! Seriously!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-7
Text (JP): 運転が荒っぽいったらありゃしない！こっちが避けなきゃ、ぶつかるようなところに、強引に頭入れてきてさ！ドライバーも「痛い目見たくなかったら避けな」って顔してやがんのよ！
Text (EN): Their driving is absolutely reckless! They force their way in where we'd crash if we didn't dodge! And the drivers have this "move or get hurt" look on their faces!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-7
Text (JP): 色々と新しいチームが増えたのは、ここが楽しくなって良いんだけどさぁ。ああいう暴力的な走りをする奴らって、ホント最低っ！！あいつらとは二度とバトルはしないわ。
Text (EN): It's great that all these new teams are popping up and making things more exciting around here. But those guys who drive like violent maniacs? They're the absolute worst!! I'm never racing against them again.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-8
Text (JP): あっ！あんた観光客だろ？この前、湾岸線であった大規模チェインバトルに参加してたんだってな。
Text (EN): Hey! You're 【{bad_name}】, right? I heard you were in that Large-scale Chain Battle on the Bayshore Line the other day.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-8
Text (JP): これまで一匹狼で通して来たあんたが、ついにチームを組むってワケか。首都環状の勢力図が、また大きく変化しそうだなっ！
Text (EN): So the lone wolf who's always rolled solo is finally putting together a team, huh? The power balance on the Shuto Expressway is about to shift big time!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-8
Text (JP): ……あれっ、そういう話じゃあないのか……。俺はてっきり、あんたも奴らの仲間入りしたんだと思っていたが……。
Text (EN): ...Wait, that's not what's happening? I was totally convinced you'd joined up with those guys...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-8
Text (JP): そういうことなら、まだ俺にもチャンスはあるってことだよな！？俺とチームを組んでくれよ〜。お前ほどの実力者と組めば、覇権チーム間違いなしだぜ。
Text (EN): So that means I still have a chance, right?! Come on, team up with me! With someone as skilled as you, we'd be the top dogs for sure.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-8
Text (JP): ……え、まずはお前にバトルで勝たなきゃダメ？ダメかぁ〜。勝てっこねえよ〜。
Text (EN): ...What? I have to beat you in a battle first? No way... There's no chance I could win...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 一徹ストレートとマネードリームは、腐れ縁って感じね。
Text (EN): 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 and 【MONEY DREAM】 are like... Frenemies, I guess.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 詳しい経緯はもう、誰も覚えてないんだけど……２人が初めて出会った時、PAでお互いのマシンを見て、ひと悶着あったらしいのよ。
Text (EN): Nobody remembers all the details anymore, but... When they first met, they saw each other's machines at a Parking Area and got into some kind of beef.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): まあ、要するに……「マシンがダサい」とか「名前がダサい」とか、しょうもない内容。喧嘩っ早い人って、イヤよね〜。
Text (EN): Basically, it was just... "Your ride looks lame" or "Your name sucks"—real petty stuff. I can't stand people with such short fuses.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): とにかく、つい最近まであの2人は、顔を見れば大喧嘩！雰囲気は最悪だったわ。周りは揉め事に巻き込まれないように、そそくさ退散する感じ。
Text (EN): Anyway, until recently those two would get into huge fights every time they crossed paths! The atmosphere was absolutely toxic. Everyone around would just scatter to avoid getting caught up in their drama.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 口論の果てに「バトルで決着をつけよう」なんて流れにもなるけど、どっちも相当な実力者だから、勝ったり負けたり……拮抗状態ね。
Text (EN): Their arguments would eventually lead to "Let's settle this with a battle," but they're both incredibly skilled, so they'd just trade wins. Total stalemate.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): そこに、久遠のポラリスが現れたの。
Text (EN): Then 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 showed up.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 彼女たち3人が初めてバトルしたあの夜のことは、湾岸の走り屋の間では“伝説の一戦”として語り継がれているわ。限界ギリギリをさらに越えていくような、過酷な最高速バトル――。
Text (EN): That night when the three of them first battled is still talked about among Bayshore racers as "the legendary showdown." It was an extreme high-speed battle that pushed way past everyone's limits...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 何もかも正反対な一徹ストレートとマネードリームだけど、久遠のポラリスへの評価は、完全に一致したようね。
Text (EN): 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 and 【MONEY DREAM】 are complete opposites in every way, but their opinion of 【ETERNAL POLARIS】? Totally in sync.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 今じゃ、2人ともすっかり丸くなって、つるむことも増えたわ。マネードリームは久遠のポラリスのこと、妹みたいにかわいがってるようだし……
Text (EN): Now they've both mellowed out completely and hang out more often. 【MONEY DREAM】 seems to dote on 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 like a little sister.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 4-9
Text (JP): 一徹ストレートは、「テッペン目指す最高の仲間」……だなんて暑っ苦しいこと堂々と吹聴してるの。人って変わるものなのねえ。
Text (EN): And 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 goes around proudly declaring they're "the ultimate crew aiming for the top" or whatever. People really do change, huh?

Heading: Rumor 4-10
Text (JP): <Neo Limited>が<UNLIMITED>にバトルを申し込んだらしいぜ。ここ数年間、お互い不完全燃焼の感があった因縁の両チームが、久々に激突するとはな。
Text (EN): Word is 《Neo Limited》 challenged 《UNLIMITED》 to a battle. These two rival teams have been feeling unsatisfied for years, and now they're finally going at it again.

Heading: Rumor 4-10
Text (JP): 俺が聞いた話じゃ<Free Way>が<2 Limit>に、合同走行会の話を持ち掛けたそうだ。
Text (EN): What I heard was that 《Free Way》 approached 《2 Limit》 about doing a joint cruise session.

Heading: Rumor 4-10
Text (JP): もちろん合同走行会なんて言ってはいるがね、要は一緒に走って、自分たちの方が上だってことを知らしめたいのさ。
Text (EN): Of course, they're just calling it a "joint cruise session;" what they really want is to run together and prove they're superior.

Heading: Rumor 4-10
Text (JP): あの男の登場によって、色んなチームの“競争意識”に火がついた。自分たちの存在感、優位性を証明したくてたまらないんだろう。
Text (EN): That guy's arrival has lit a fire under all these teams' competitive spirits. They're desperate to prove their presence and dominance.

Heading: Rumor 4-10
Text (JP): つまり……観光客の奴が、みんなのバランスを崩したってことだ。
Text (EN): In other words... 【{bad_name}】 has thrown everyone's balance out of whack.
